dimensions.detail: The artifacts coherently describe an optimization guide for reducing OpenClaw/Claude Max token use through model routing, compaction, workspace cleanup, and maintenance scripts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The guide includes user-applied instructions for session resets, file moves, crontab entries, and limiting command output; these are related to the stated purpose but should be reviewed before use.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown and metadata only, with no executable scripts, dependency installs, or automatic runtime behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The suggested commands target OpenClaw workspace and session paths, which is proportionate to the optimization purpose, but users should adapt paths and retention settings to their own environment.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The guide recommends persistent cron jobs, including archiving and deleting old session archives, but this persistence is disclosed and requires the user to install it manually.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The cron-based session trimmer and deletion advice is purpose-aligned for maintenance and token efficiency, but users should add backups, dry-runs, and retention review before enabling deletion.
[SQP-2] expected: Session reset advice is related to controlling context growth, but users should only reset after work is saved or summarized because resets can discard useful context.
llm.guidance: Before installing or following the guide, review any cron jobs and deletion commands carefully. Treat the maintenance scripts as examples: test them first, confirm the session paths are correct, back up anything needed for audit or recovery, and avoid automatic resets until active work is checkpointed.
llm.summary: This is a token-efficiency guide with disclosed manual configuration and cron suggestions; it has some data-loss risks if followed blindly, but no hidden execution or malicious behavior was found.
